03/Dated: 17th January, 2024
1. Heard the parties.
2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Spl. POCSO.
Case No.99 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376, 450, 452 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 4/8 of the POCSO Act,
pending in the court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-III-cum-Spl. Judge, POCSO, Act, Hazaribag.
opennyai_summary.arguments: 3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is just below the age of 18 years.
opennyai_summary.decision:
4. In view of the above submission, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw the present anticipatory bail application with a liberty to approach the appropriate Forum for declaration of Juvenility.
5. Permission is accorded.
6. Accordingly, the present anticipatory bail application is hereby, dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
7. If any such application is filed, the Court below is directed to look into the matter and proceed in accordance with law as early as possible.
